content: Multiplicity of AttributeValueVariationPoint • If the original attribute had a multiplicity of 1, then exactly one {Type}ValueVariationPoint is generated. • If the original attribute was an array (i.e., it had a multiplicity of [0 : : :  ] , [1 : : :  ] or more generally [ m : : : n ] , then as many {Type}ValueVariationPoint s shall be created as there are entries in the array.
